flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
